newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates stable in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates stable in thin trade.

text.p: Bulgaria's interbank deposit rates were unchanged from Thursday in thin trade as demand for funds was very low due to generally high free liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
"Some banks were bidding for small amounts of funds, mainly for up to two days, to meet short-term payments," said a dealer.
Overnight depo rates stood at 1.75-2.0 percent annually, unchanged from Thursday. Spot week rates were around 3.5-4.0 percent annual, also flat.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.22 percent on Thursday, down from 3.21 percent on Wednesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank on Thursday said it will cut its simple annual main interest rate to 5.42 percent from 6.12 percent, effective from July 28. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
